fruits.extendedStory: Artists began borrowing this corner with Walt Disney's Pinocchio in 1940. Ever since, whenever someone needs a typical medieval European backdrop, the Plönlein turns up again. The half-timbered house and the two wall towers belong to the Plönlein too. The fountain itself is dated 1607, far older than any film. Look at its carved six-sided basin, its column and its iron railing.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Künstler leihen sich diese Ecke seit 1940 aus, angefangen mit Walt Disneys Pinocchio. Seitdem taucht das Plönlein auf, wann immer jemand eine typische mittelalterliche Kulisse aus Europa braucht. Auch das Fachwerkhaus und die zwei Mauertürme gehören zum Plönlein. Der Brunnen selbst trägt die Jahreszahl 1607, viel älter als jeder Film. Schau dir das verzierte sechseckige Becken an, die Säule und das eiserne Gitter.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Artists began borrowing this corner with Walt Disney's Pinocchio in 1940. Ever since, whenever someone needs a typical medieval European backdrop, the Plönlein turns up again. The half-timbered house and the two wall towers belong to the Plönlein too. The fountain itself is dated 1607, far older than any film. Look at its carved six-sided basin, its column and its iron railing.

localizedStory.de: Plönlein heißt kleiner Platz am Brunnen. Dieser Brunnen hat also der ganzen Ecke um dich herum ihren Namen gegeben.
localizedStory.en: Plönlein means little square by the fountain. So this fountain gave its name to the whole corner around you.

fruits.name: Brunnen am Plönlein
fruits.story: Plönlein means little square by the fountain. So this fountain gave its name to the whole corner around you.

fruits.extendedStory: That choir above the street holds the Holy Blood chapel. The church's Holy Blood relic sits in a rock-crystal capsule, in the cross above Tilman Riemenschneider's altar. The story goes that it is one drop, spilled from the chalice at communion, which became the blood of Christ. The backs of the altar's side wings show an early picture of Rothenburg itself, beside rare scenes of St James pilgrims.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Dieser Chor über der Straße birgt die Heilig-Blut-Kapelle. Die Heilig-Blut-Reliquie der Kirche liegt in einer Kapsel aus Bergkristall, im Kreuz über dem Altar von Tilman Riemenschneider. Der Sage nach ist sie ein Tropfen, der beim Abendmahl aus dem Kelch verschüttet wurde und dabei zum Blut Christi wurde. Die Rückseiten der Seitenflügel zeigen ein frühes Bild von Rothenburg selbst, dazu seltene Szenen von Jakobspilgern.
localizedExtendedStory.en: That choir above the street holds the Holy Blood chapel. The church's Holy Blood relic sits in a rock-crystal capsule, in the cross above Tilman Riemenschneider's altar. The story goes that it is one drop, spilled from the chalice at communion, which became the blood of Christ. The backs of the altar's side wings show an early picture of Rothenburg itself, beside rare scenes of St James pilgrims.

localizedStory.de: Unter dieser Kirche läuft eine Straße hindurch. Ihr Westchor wurde direkt über die Klingengasse gebaut, du kannst also unten durchgehen.
localizedStory.en: A street runs straight through under this church. Its west choir was built right over the Klingengasse, so you can walk beneath it.

fruits.name: St. Jakob
fruits.story: A street runs straight through under this church. Its west choir was built right over the Klingengasse, so you can walk beneath it.

fruits.extendedStory: Until the Rothenburg district was dissolved, this knights' house was the district office. Then it was sold to the Hinckeldey family, who ran the museum's collection, and in 1977 the museum moved in. Inside, the museum counts about 50,000 objects. They tell over a thousand years of German and European legal history, the story of how laws and courts worked.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Bis der Landkreis Rothenburg aufgelöst wurde, saß in diesem Johanniterhaus das Landratsamt. Dann kaufte es die Familie Hinckeldey, die die Sammlung des Museums führte, und 1977 zog das Museum ein. Drinnen zählt das Museum rund 50.000 Stücke. Sie erzählen von über tausend Jahren deutscher und europäischer Rechtsgeschichte, also davon, wie Gesetze und Gerichte funktionierten.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Until the Rothenburg district was dissolved, this knights' house was the district office. Then it was sold to the Hinckeldey family, who ran the museum's collection, and in 1977 the museum moved in. Inside, the museum counts about 50,000 objects. They tell over a thousand years of German and European legal history, the story of how laws and courts worked.

localizedStory.de: Dieses Museum wohnt in einem Haus der Johanniter. Die Kirche St. Johannis nebenan entstand zusammen mit ihm, vor über sechs Jahrhunderten.
localizedStory.en: This museum fills a house of the Knights of St John. The church next door was built together with it, over six centuries ago.

fruits.name: Mittelalterliches Kriminalmuseum
fruits.story: This museum fills a house of the Knights of St John. The church next door was built together with it, over six centuries ago.

fruits.extendedStory: That clay was just 45 centimetres thick, with firm ground beneath it. The Franciscans, friars who lived from gifts, began this church in 1282. It is counted the best-preserved church of such a begging order in Franconia. Its rood screen, the wall that parted the friars' choir from the nave, is still in place.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Lehmschicht war nur 45 Zentimeter stark, erst darunter kam tragfähiger Grund. Die Franziskaner, Ordensbrüder, die von Gaben lebten, begannen diese Kirche 1282. Sie gilt als die am besten erhaltene Kirche eines Bettelordens in Franken. Ihr Lettner, die Wand zwischen dem Chor der Brüder und dem Kirchenschiff, steht noch an seinem Platz.
localizedExtendedStory.en: That clay was just 45 centimetres thick, with firm ground beneath it. The Franciscans, friars who lived from gifts, began this church in 1282. It is counted the best-preserved church of such a begging order in Franconia. Its rood screen, the wall that parted the friars' choir from the nave, is still in place.

localizedStory.de: Der Westgiebel dieser Franziskanerkirche stand auf dünnem Lehm und kippte über die Jahrhunderte nach außen. Heute halten ihn Stahlanker in den oberen Mauern.
localizedStory.en: This Franciscan church's west gable stood on thin clay and tipped outward over the centuries. Steel rods through its upper walls now hold it in.

fruits.name: Franziskanerkirche
fruits.story: This Franciscan church's west gable stood on thin clay and tipped outward over the centuries. Steel rods through its upper walls now hold it in.

fruits.extendedStory: The view behind that nickname is from the Kalkturm in the hospital quarter, looking north across the town. This tower began as a watchtower on the town hall's west gable. Its core is over eight centuries old, and it took its present shape from 1555. Today 220 steps lead up to its viewing platform.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Den Blick hinter diesem Spitznamen hat man vom Kalkturm im Spitalviertel aus, nach Norden über die Stadt. Dieser Turm begann als Wachturm am Westgiebel des Rathauses. Sein Kern ist über acht Jahrhunderte alt, seine heutige Form bekam er ab 1555. Heute führen 220 Stufen hinauf zur Aussichtsplattform.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The view behind that nickname is from the Kalkturm in the hospital quarter, looking north across the town. This tower began as a watchtower on the town hall's west gable. Its core is over eight centuries old, and it took its present shape from 1555. Today 220 steps lead up to its viewing platform.

localizedStory.de: Rothenburgs Spitzname ist das fränkische Jerusalem. Seine vielen Türme, dieser hier mit dabei, erinnern viele an den Blick auf den Tempelberg.
localizedStory.en: Rothenburg's nickname is the Franconian Jerusalem. Its skyline of towers, this one among them, reminds many people of the Temple Mount.

fruits.name: Rathausturm
fruits.story: Rothenburg's nickname is the Franconian Jerusalem. Its skyline of towers, this one among them, reminds many people of the Temple Mount.

fruits.extendedStory: At the outer gate stand two little houses, kept for the toll and for the guards. The gate tower itself burned out down to its walls at the end of the Second World War. Rebuilding began soon after, largely with help from the Verein Alt-Rothenburg, a local society. Today 103 steps lead up to the tower room.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Am Vortor stehen zwei kleine Häuschen, für den Zoll und für die Wache. Der Torturm selbst brannte am Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs bis auf die Mauern aus. Schon bald danach begann der Wiederaufbau, getragen vor allem vom Verein Alt-Rothenburg. Heute führen 103 Stufen hinauf in die Turmstube.
localizedExtendedStory.en: At the outer gate stand two little houses, kept for the toll and for the guards. The gate tower itself burned out down to its walls at the end of the Second World War. Rebuilding began soon after, largely with help from the Verein Alt-Rothenburg, a local society. Today 103 steps lead up to the tower room.

localizedStory.de: Dieses Vortor trägt die Jahreszahl 1649, kurz nach dem Dreißigjährigen Krieg. Durch die Industrialisierung sind solche Vorbauten in Deutschland extrem selten geworden.
localizedStory.en: This outer gate is dated 1649, just after the Thirty Years' War. Since the industrial age, outworks like it have become extremely rare in Germany.

fruits.name: Rödertor
fruits.story: This outer gate is dated 1649, just after the Thirty Years' War. Since the industrial age, outworks like it have become extremely rare in Germany.

fruits.extendedStory: Its nickname, the Shepherds' Church, comes from the shepherds' brotherhood. Every year its members held their festival service here, on the Tuesday after St Bartholomew's Day. They also gave the church an altar. On it stands their patron, St Wendelin, holding a shepherd's crook and horn. The church went up from 1475.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Ihr Spitzname Schäferskirche kommt von der Schäferbruderschaft. Jedes Jahr feierten ihre Mitglieder hier den Festgottesdienst, am Dienstag nach Bartholomäi. Sie stifteten der Kirche auch einen Altar. Darauf steht ihr Schutzheiliger Wendelin mit Hirtenstab und Hirtenhorn. Die Kirche entstand ab 1475.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Its nickname, the Shepherds' Church, comes from the shepherds' brotherhood. Every year its members held their festival service here, on the Tuesday after St Bartholomew's Day. They also gave the church an altar. On it stands their patron, St Wendelin, holding a shepherd's crook and horn. The church went up from 1475.

localizedStory.de: Diese Kirche sieht aus wie eine Burg. Sie sitzt obendrauf auf den Geschützräumen der Bastei am Klingentor, einem Teil der Stadtbefestigung.
localizedStory.en: This fortress-like church stands right on top of the gun chambers of the Klingentor bastion, part of the town's defences.

fruits.name: St.-Wolfgangs-Kirche
fruits.story: This fortress-like church stands right on top of the gun chambers of the Klingentor bastion, part of the town's defences.

fruits.extendedStory: Its other name is the Hundsturm, the dog tower. The story goes that dogs were kept to guard the town moats. Count its four little six-sided watch turrets under a steep pyramid roof. On the side facing the fields, look for two coats of arms. One belongs to the Empire, the other to the town.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Sein anderer Name ist Hundsturm. Man erzählt, dass Hunde gehalten wurden, die die Stadtgräben bewachten. Zähl seine vier kleinen, sechseckigen Wachtürmchen unter dem steilen Pyramidendach. Auf der Feldseite, also nach außen zum Land hin, findest du zwei Wappen. Eines gehört dem Reich, das andere der Stadt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Its other name is the Hundsturm, the dog tower. The story goes that dogs were kept to guard the town moats. Count its four little six-sided watch turrets under a steep pyramid roof. On the side facing the fields, look for two coats of arms. One belongs to the Empire, the other to the town.

localizedStory.de: Schau dir die auffällig schmale Tordurchfahrt dieses Turms an. Sie wurde im späten Mittelalter zugemauert, und niemand weiß, wann oder warum.
localizedStory.en: Look for this tower's strikingly narrow gateway. It was bricked up in the late Middle Ages, and nobody knows when or why.

fruits.name: Stöberleinsturm
fruits.story: Look for this tower's strikingly narrow gateway. It was bricked up in the late Middle Ages, and nobody knows when or why.
